_doc: Ratchets on the files that only ever grow. `node tools/check/ratchets.mjs` checks, `--update` snaps every ceiling to the current value (lower after an extraction; a raise is a deliberate edit with its reason in the commit). Metrics: lines (split-newline), codeLines (non-comment non-blank), gMembers (G facade members, check-gctx), topLets (column-0 `let`). Tree-wide metrics (scope `tree`, measured by tools/check/tree-counts.mjs): cssClasses (distinct class tokens in css/), shellNodes (index.html tag occurrences less script/link), bareCatches (empty, uncommented catch blocks in js/), waitNoPolling (waitForFunction with a declared timeout and no polling), waitForTimeout (fixed `waitForTimeout(` sleeps under tests/specs + tests/helpers — convert to `__apex` condition waits with `{ polling: 100 }` as they are touched), and the four CSS token-adoption counts subFloorFontSize / rawSpacing / rawColor / rawColorDistinct, which carry `slack: 0` because they have always asserted exact equality — a migration must lower them, not bank headroom. Three coverage-shaped tree metrics (2026-09-22, all `slack: 0`, shrink-only): zeroRefModules (manifest modules nothing under tests/ names by path, basename or global — tools/check/tree-counts.mjs), implicitAsserts (live spec tests whose only assertion is a wait — tools/ci/assert-audit.mjs `implicit`), twinDebt (browser specs tools/check/vm-portable.mjs finds portable that no TWINNED/ADAPTED entry or BROWSER_ONLY reason covers — tools/ci/twinned-specs.mjs). `node tools/check/tree-counts.mjs --offenders` prints the breakdown behind any of them. An entry may declare its own `slack` when its guard is TIGHTER than the default max(60, 4%) — all four of these are, and a slack looser than the default is refused, so consolidating mechanisms cannot quietly widen one. The boot wall (2026-11-20, Bryce's B+D, docs/notes/RATCHET-REVIEW-2026-11-20.md): eagerCodeBytes counts the eager scripts with comments and spare whitespace stripped (tools/lib/js-strip.mjs), what a boot parses, replacing raw eagerBytes; its `absorb` lets a branch's own growth up to 5000 B be the commit hook's fragment with no label, and past it the raise is Bryce's `ratchet-raise`. eagerScripts stays exact. The pin absorb (2026-11-20, Bryce's "Pin slack", D-037): assertPins and assertPinsAll carry `absorb: 5` the same way, so a branch's own growth of up to 5 pin-shaped asserts since its merge base is the commit hook's fragment; past 5 it is `ratchet-raise`. The ceilings did not move. History: docs/notes/CEILING-HISTORY.md.

assertPinsAll.baseline: 2026-11-10 (audit item 9): re-seeded at the TRUE count after the counter learned the indirect shape (a bool from includes()/test()/indexOf() that a later assert reads); was 10320 under the old counter, +39 indirect sites. Shrink-only: lower it as those sites are rewritten, never raise it to absorb them.
